neighbours.label: ' brings' or ' bringing' in a running total ('this brings the number up to')
fire: We hired two more nurses. This brings the staff up to forty.
She scored again, bringing the team total to nine.
Three new shops opened. This brings the count to sixty.
Another win brings their record up to eight.
The gift brings the fund up to two million.
He sold one more, bringing the season total to fifty.
Today's rain brings the monthly figure up to ten inches.
Four more joined, bringing the membership to ninety.
quiet: We hired two more nurses. This is the staff list for the ward.
She scored again and the team went home.
Three new shops opened. This is the street with sixty.
Another win pleased their coach and fans.
The gift pleased the fund and the board.
He sold one more and went home for the season.
Today's rain filled the pond behind the barn.
Four more joined and sat near the front.

notes: Whitespace and ' self' on the card are not covered.
